name: Sprout Social
label: Sprout Social Public API v1
description: Official Sprout Social Public API v1 at https://api.sproutsocial.com. OfficialApiNode. Draft publishing (message_create), retrieve (message_get), profile analytics (analytics_get), media upload (media_upload). Bearer access_token. customer_id is a path variable. Eligible plan + API Permissions required. Never log access_token.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Path vars customer_id and publishing_post_id may come from config. media is type file. Do not put access_token here. Example: {"operation":"message_get","publishing_post_id":"…"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'message_create' | 'message_get' | 'analytics_get' | 'media_upload'.

schema.label: customer_id
schema.description: Path {customer_id}. Falls back to config. Discover via GET /v1/metadata/client.

schema.label: publishing_post_id
schema.description: Calendar post id for message_get. Required for that operation.

schema.label: group_id
schema.description: Sprout group id. Required for message_create.

schema.label: customer_profile_ids
schema.description: Profile ids in the group. Required for message_create.

schema.label: is_draft
schema.description: Must be true for message_create (draft-only create on Public API v1).

schema.label: scheduled_times
schema.description: ISO-8601 UTC future times. Seconds rounded down to the minute.

schema.label: delivery_type
schema.description: Only SCHEDULED when scheduling a draft.

schema.label: media_ids
schema.description: Array of { media_id, media_type } PHOTO | VIDEO | DOCUMENT.

schema.label: filters
schema.description: analytics_get JSON body (profiles, date range, metrics). Cap date range.

schema.label: metrics
schema.description: analytics_get Owned Profile Analytics body metrics (with filters). Example: {"metrics":["lifetime.impressions"]}.

schema.label: media
schema.description: Platform file ref-id for media_upload. Cap 50_000_000 bytes. Never inline bytes.

schema.label: media_type
schema.description: Hint PHOTO | VIDEO | DOCUMENT for media_upload.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: message_create | message_get | analytics_get | media_upload.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: Sprout account token or OAuth JWT. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret only. Never log or place on INPUT. Settings → Global Features → API.

configurationParameters.label: Customer ID
configurationParameters.description: Sprout customer id used as path {customer_id}. Discover via GET /v1/metadata/client.

configurationParameters.label: Metrics
configurationParameters.description: analytics_get body metrics alongside filters. Example: ["lifetime.impressions"].

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 30. Use 60 for media_upload. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
